title: PbtA Roll Helper
description: A production-ready PbtA roll helper for Foundry VTT with macro rolls, native sheet-roll styling, Dice So Nice support, synced interactive choices, a configurable resource-spend mechanic (e.g. Bedlam Hall Prestige), adapters, cached parsing, and distinctive art-direction themes.

recommends.reason: Adds animated 3D dice with PbtA-themed colorsets for rolls made through this module.
